# Preparation bounds and actual changes in joint realization

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> A course carries every bound on realizing a bundle together, its own moves counted. In the activation law one preparation step changes the current capacity, the release loses what was eventually reachable, and a prepared configuration can still end one-sided.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Under a fixed relational law and realization interpretation, joint realization within n steps after an actual prefix is reachable through the same intermediate configuration within prefix length plus n steps. The existing joint-activation law supplies changed one-step capacity after preparation, loss of joint realization at every finite horizon after release, and a path leaving available joint capacity unused. Unbounded backward reachability repeats the established inference and is not counted as another result.

Canonical source: [ActivationCapacity.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/ActivationCapacity.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- One fixed process, stable endpoint meanings and an admitted finite prefix; all claims in a bundle share one history and endpoint.
- Event counts start at each current configuration and do not automatically represent physical duration; a common absolute deadline must count the preparation already spent.
- The application reuses JointContinuationClassification’s supplied coupling, event law and terminal configurations without claiming the coupling’s causal origin.
- Logic, representation and the existential interpretation remain explicit; no probability, optimal policy, infinite continuation or input from living significance and the practical commitments is supplied.

Preparation, joint activation and release differentiate continuations within one activity. Trace concatenation retains the same intermediate configuration; twoSteps_meaning preserves the original realization semantics. The delta is a bounded refinement and application to an existing common activity. The prior possibility interface retains the ancestral-reachability/formed-condition/exercise distinction and its actual contact-formation evidence.
